name: DataPlane.org
tier_rationale: Long-running operator community project with an identifiable maintainer and public documentation (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Sensor reports of a 7-day window; the feed itself says it is informational and not a block list.

sshclient.title: DataPlane sshclient report (ASN | ASname | ipaddr | lastseen | category)

terms.quote: Noncommercial, off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared: blocklist.de, CINS, ET compromised IPs, GreenSnow and DataPlane (A1 BR16), VoIPBL, and the FireHOL level1 aggregate (it embeds noncommercial upstreams such as DShield).

sshclient.notes: Quote: binding council text (P149 cond 2); research C0375 terms 'free for NON-commercial use only; no redistribution' (verified_live 200). LOW fidelity (informational report). Used by ip_blocklists.
sshclient.licensed_alternative: The open feeds of ip_blocklists (Spamhaus DROP/ASN-DROP, abuse.ch Feodo Tracker and SSLBL, IPsum, Binary Defense) keep running; a licence_allow entry recording the operator's written permission enables this feed.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P149). Downloaded whole by the dataset manager (conditional GET, validation) and matched locally: no value is ever sent. Never redistributed outside the team (P149 cond 2).
